messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['If this proposal is acceptable by you, please do not make undue advantage of the trust I bestow on you, and your urgent reply is highly needed today, for more detailed information and oral talks.', 'If you accept this offer, I will appreciate your timely response.', 'When you receive this letter, Kindly send me an e-mailsignifying Your acceptance or otherwise, include your private Telephone numbers for more explanation and confidential communication.', 'I want an individual, or a Charity Organization that will use this fund for orphanages, widows, and helping land mine victims worldwide.', 'I need you to help me to get the box and keep it until I can escape and meet you, and you will also help me to invest the money in your country or where it is good.', 'Accept Decline', 'IS THIS PROPOSITION ATTAINABLE?', 'IS THIS PROPOSITION ATTAINABLE?', 'If you are interested, please reply immediately.', 'Thus, if you are willing to assist us move this fund out of Congo, you can contact me through my email address above with your telephone, fax number and personal information to enable us discuss the modalities and what will be your share(percentage) for assisting us.', 'I seek your consent to present you as the next of kin of the deceased since you are from the same country so that the proceeds of this account valued at Fifteen Million (US$15million) can be paid to you and then you and me can share the money.', 'If you are satisfied with this and agree to co-operate with me, kindly reply me with your YOUR BANK ACCOUNT NUMBERSYOUR BANKS ADDRESS AND TELEPHONE NUMBERS AND FAX NUMBERS YOUR PRIVATE PARTICULARSYOUR PRIVATE TELEPHONE NUMBERSYOUR PRIVATE FAX NUMBERSYOUR CONTACT ADDRESS which will enable me reach you easily during the process of this transaction.', 'Please indicate your position through this email so that I will furnish you with the details.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
